About the author

Rob Jackson is the President of Magnovo Training Group, a leadership, teambuilding and communications development training company. He is a member of the Global Speakers Federation (GSF), and a professional member of the National Speakers Association (NSA). As an internationally requested keynote speaker and professional development trainer, Rob lives in Indianapolis, IN with his family but proudly hails from Salinas, CA. Rob enjoys traveling, scuba diving and most of all making a difference in the lives and careers of individuals.
